name: asset-l10-dispersal-fan
note: L10 giant ventilation fan housing with the rotor, courier for scale. Look for: rotor blades inside the duct without cutting the ring, guard grille, plinth grounded, ring not floating. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read.
